label: YouTube

sensitivePaths.label: Edit a video's title or description

agentGuide: Base path /youtube/v3; every call needs part=. My channel: GET /channels?mine=true&part=snippet,statistics,contentDetails (contentDetails.relatedPlaylists.uploads is the playlist of my videos). Videos of a playlist: GET /playlistItems?playlistId=<id>&part=snippet,contentDetails&maxResults=25; my playlists: GET /playlists?mine=true&part=snippet. Search: GET /search?q=<words>&part=snippet&type=video&maxResults=10 (costs 100 quota units: search sparingly); a video: GET /videos?id=<id>&part=snippet,statistics,contentDetails (viewCount, likeCount, duration ISO 8601); comments: GET /commentThreads?videoId=<id>&part=snippet&maxResults=20. Subscriptions: GET /subscriptions?mine=true&part=snippet. Edit a video's title or description: PUT /videos?part=snippet {"id": "...", "snippet": {"title": "...", "description": "...", "categoryId": "22"}}; add to a playlist: POST /playlistItems?part=snippet {"snippet": {"playlistId": "...", "resourceId": {"kind": "youtube#video", "videoId": "..."}}}. Uploads go through another endpoint not offered here. The daily quota is 10 000 units: a list costs 1, a search 100.
